authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Wager Strike
authoredRecords.description: Play one card and stake Fortune before a 2d6 wager. On 8+, return twice the stake and add the stake to this strike; on loss the stake is gone.

resourceCost.somaticText: Present the class focus and deliberately declare the operation; its exact choices precede resolution.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Recut
authoredRecords.description: Once on your own turn discard up to two cards, reshuffle discard only if the deck is empty, then draw into up to two empty sockets. If broke and you actually discarded a card, recover one Fortune.

resourceCost.somaticText: Present the class focus and deliberately declare the operation; its exact choices precede resolution.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Lucky Toss
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune escrow; 2d6 >=8 returns 2 Fortune and deals 1d8 + 2 wyrd, otherwise no return and zero damage. One instant wager.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Beginner’s Cover
authoredRecords.description: Discard one actual card; one willing ally including self within 30ft receives ward 2, one original damage use until next caster own-turn start. No Fortune gain.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Cheat’s Sleight
authoredRecords.description: Discard one card for +2 to the next otherwise legal Sleight of Hand check involving one declared hand-held object within 10 minutes. Never automatically steals, moves, duplicates or conceals it.

effects.scope: One declared hand-held object

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Read the Stakeholders
authoredRecords.description: Inspect one visible wager/exchange within 30ft. GM identifies one observable omission or inconsistency, if present, in publicly stated stake/settlement/cancellation terms. No hidden terms or truth detection; repeats need a material change.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Read the Table
authoredRecords.description: Inspect the next card of your own deck and one publicly observable tell of a game or wager. You learn no hidden opponent cards and do not change deck order.

resourceCost.somaticText: Present the class focus and deliberately declare the operation; its exact choices precede resolution.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Gambler’s Insight
authoredRecords.description: Discard one card for +2 to one Insight check about one observed actor’s conduct within 30ft, used within 10 minutes. No lie detection, private intentions or memories.

effects.scope: Observable conduct of one actor within 30ft

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Fool’s Gold
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune: visually disguise one real hand-sized object as coins, gaming counters or jewelry for 10 minutes. Unattended object or consenting holder, touch. No weight/material/value/writing/magic/credential change; physical examination exposes the mismatch. Observation is GM-adjudicated.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Cut the Deck
authoredRecords.description: Once per own turn, discard exactly one chosen hand card, draw the actual top card into its socket. Requires one deck card; no inspection, selection among draws or shuffle.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Dice Dart
authoredRecords.description: One card, 1–2 Fortune escrow, one enemy within 60ft. 2d6 >=8 returns twice stake and deals 2d6 + stake wyrd; loss returns zero and deals 1d6. Settle once.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Matched Step
authoredRecords.description: Discard an exact equal-rank pair. One willing ally including self within 30ft immediately moves up to 10ft using remaining legal movement. No ward or Fortune gain.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Poker Face
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune: +2 to one Deception check to conceal a declared motive or maintain a bluff within 10 minutes. No immunity to interrogation, evidence, observation or magic.

effects.scope: Conceal one declared motive or maintain one bluff

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Dead Pot Etiquette
authoredRecords.description: Discard one card for +2 to one Persuasion check within 10 minutes to establish a mutually accepted parley, game or safe settlement procedure with willing interlocutors within 30ft. No forced ceasefire, disarm or enforcement.

effects.scope: Mutually accepted parley/game/settlement with willing interlocutors within 30ft

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Solitaire’s Guard
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune; ward 5 on one willing ally including self within 30ft, one use until next caster own-turn start.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Mirage Flip
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune escrow. Declare before 2d6: 8+ returns 2 Fortune and self ward 7; loss returns zero and self ward 2. Both one use until next caster own-turn start. No foreign roll changes.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Spot the Weight
authoredRecords.description: Consume one Fortune for +3 to one Investigation check within 10 minutes on an actual gaming device at touch. Finds only physically supported weighting, marks, false compartments or dealing faults; attended devices require access/consent.

effects.scope: Physical weighting, marked surfaces, compartments or dealing faults in one actual touched gaming device

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Insured Exit
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune. One willing ally including self within 30ft immediately moves up to 10ft using remaining legal movement, with ordinary consequences and no refund or reaction immunity.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Hot Streak
authoredRecords.description: One card and two Fortune. Until next caster own-turn start, next winning optional damaging wager gains +1d8 raw wyrd after original critical calculation. One charge; losses do not consume it. Grand Wager names one recipient before rolling. No stacked charges, resource generation, core/signature/capstone change or new damage event.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Three-Card Passage
authoredRecords.description: Discard three distinct consecutive ranks, suits unrestricted. Up to two willing allies including self, each within 30ft, immediately move up to 15ft using remaining legal movement.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Open Ledger
authoredRecords.description: Discard one card: +2 to one Investigation check within 10 minutes examining one accessible ledger at touch, tracing payment, arithmetic or altered entry. No missing pages or proof of intent supplied.

effects.scope: Trace payment/arithmetic discrepancy/altered entry in one accessible touched ledger

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Safe Pot
authoredRecords.description: An equal-rank pair and one Fortune give up to two willing allies including self within 30ft ward 5 each, one use until next caster own-turn start. No shared damage pool.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: House Advantage
authoredRecords.description: One card and two Fortune. Up to two willing allies including self within 30ft each declare Investigation or Persuasion before commitment and gain +2 on their next such check about one shared named activity within 10 minutes. No attack/save bonus or enemy penalty.

effects.scope: One shared named game, negotiation or account

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Twin Cut
authoredRecords.description: Once per own turn, discard two selected cards, draw the actual next two deck cards. Requires two deck cards, or one when learned Discard Memory legally replaces one draw. Receive exactly two; never shuffle or recover Fortune.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Price the Route
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune: +3 to one Survival check within 10 minutes to appraise a visible route segment within 60ft. On success GM identifies one supported visible hazard and warning. No hidden-trap detection, safe-path guarantee or prediction.

effects.scope: Visible travel hazards of one observed route segment within 60ft

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Sealed Reserve
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune: self ward 4, one use, expiry end of the second subsequent caster own turn. Not stored Fortune or temp HP.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Death Roll
authoredRecords.description: One card and two Fortune escrow, one enemy within 30ft. 2d6 >=8 returns 4 Fortune and deals 3d8 + 2 wyrd; loss returns zero and deals 1d8. No death effect, self-damage or bankruptcy.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Escape Clause
authoredRecords.description: Discard any two distinct cards and one Fortune. Up to two willing allies including self within 30ft immediately move up to 15ft using remaining legal movement. No teleport, interception or delayed reaction.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Scrap Test
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune: +3 to one Intelligence-based check within 10 minutes to assess one touched device’s risk, tampering or suitability for a declared game. Actual access and normally required tools remain necessary; no repair or creation.

effects.scope: Operating risk/tampering/game suitability of one actual touched device; normal tools/access required

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Call the Bluff
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune: +2 to one Insight check within 10 minutes about one identified claim or wager declaration from an actor observed within 30ft. Evidence required, no compelled answer or automatic detection.

effects.scope: One explicit claim/wager declaration by an observed actor within 30ft

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Jackpot Guard
authoredRecords.description: Three same-rank cards and two Fortune. Up to three willing allies including self within 30ft receive ward 7 each, one use until next caster own-turn start.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Dealer’s Route
authoredRecords.description: Three same-suit cards and one Fortune. Self and up to two other willing allies within 30ft each immediately move up to 10ft using remaining legal movement. Pay cards once, not per recipient.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Ledger of Losses
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune: +4 to one Investigation check within 10 minutes reconstructing one named settled wager from accessible touched records. No recreated memory, missing evidence or rewritten settlement.

effects.scope: Reconstruct recorded parties/stake/outcome/unpaid obligation of one named settled wager in accessible records at touch

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Table Sweep
authoredRecords.description: Once per own turn, discard two chosen hand cards and one Fortune, privately inspect up to the next three deck cards, choose their order and return those exact cards to top. Nonempty deck required; no draw or shuffle.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Grand Wager
authoredRecords.description: Two cards and two Fortune escrow. Declare one or two distinct enemies within 30ft before one shared 2d6 roll: 8+ deals 2d8 + 1 wyrd to each and returns 4 Fortune TOTAL; loss gives zero damage/return. No target swaps or payout per target.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Merrowport Precedent
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune: +4 to one Persuasion check within 10 minutes with up to three willing creditor/debtor representatives within 30ft about restructuring one existing obligation. Every affected party must consent; no erased debt or magical covenant.

effects.scope: Restructure one actual identified obligation with willing creditor/debtor representatives within 30ft

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Five-Card Audit
authoredRecords.description: Two Fortune: privately inspect up to the actual next five deck cards and restore identical order. Nonempty deck required. No draw, selection, bottoming, shuffle or changed result.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Layered Collateral
authoredRecords.description: An equal-rank pair and one Fortune give one willing ally including self within 30ft one ward with capacity 4 PER USE and exactly two uses. Each original eligible event consumes one use; unused capacity lost. Expiry end of second subsequent caster turn. Not two stackable wards.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Final Pot
authoredRecords.description: Three distinct cards of any ranks/suits and 1–2 Fortune escrow. One enemy within 30ft: 2d6 >=8 returns twice stake and deals 4d8 + stake wyrd; loss returns zero and deals 1d8. No automatic critical or extra wager slot.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Blind Deal
authoredRecords.description: Once per completed long rest: two AP, two selected hand cards and two Fortune. After commitment inspect the actual top four, select exactly two for the vacated sockets, and put the other two at bottom in original relative order. Requires four deck cards. No generated card, guaranteed pattern, second selection or refund.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Reassign Collateral
authoredRecords.description: One card and one Fortune. Between two distinct willing allies including self within 30ft, move one existing ward created by this Gambler, preserving exact source/capacity/remaining uses/absolute expiry. No renewed duration, other caster’s ward, unresolved wager, Fortune, damage or temp HP transfer. Destination must be eligible; own-turn action, not interception.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: House Nerve
authoredRecords.description: One card and two Fortune: up to three willing allies including self within 30ft gain +3 to their next Spirit saving throw against fear before next caster own-turn start. Does not end existing fear, grant immunity, reroll, or affect other saves.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Double or Nothing
authoredRecords.description: Play one card and stake exactly three Fortune on a harder 2d6 wager. On 9+, return three times the stake and deliver the larger published strike; otherwise lose the stake.

resourceCost.somaticText: Present the class focus and deliberately declare the operation; its exact choices precede resolution.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Marked Pair
authoredRecords.description: Expose and discard two cards of the same rank to place a four-point one-use luck ward on one ally. The ward is not healing or a second Fortune bank.

resourceCost.somaticText: Present the class focus and deliberately declare the operation; its exact choices precede resolution.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Underwrite
authoredRecords.description: Before an ally rolls, stake Fortune and one card against that ally’s next eligible original single-d8 damage roll. Face5–8 pays the wager and adds two raw damage before mitigation; otherwise the stake is lost.

resourceCost.somaticText: Present the class focus and deliberately declare the operation; its exact choices precede resolution.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: The Last Stake
authoredRecords.description: Once per completed long rest. 4 AP, one card and ALL available Fortune (3–7) to escrow, one enemy within 30ft. 2d6 >=10 returns twice stake capped at 7 and deals 6d8 + twice stake wyrd; loss returns zero and deals 1d8 + 1. Settle exact card/escrow once; no self-damage, refund, extra card or guaranteed result.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: Royal Arrangement
authoredRecords.description: Once per completed long rest. 3 AP, five actual hand cards and two Fortune; choose one qualifying branch before commitment. Up to three willing allies including self within 30ft: full house (3 of one rank +2 another) gives ward 8 once until next start; straight ranks 1–5 moves each up to 15ft using remaining movement; five-card flush gives +4 raw wyrd on each recipient’s next original damaging action before next start, one declared target per action. A same-suit straight chooses ONE branch. No payout, generated pattern, extra event or arbitrary effect.

authoredRecords.manualNotice: Manual tabletop only. No automatic AP, HP, movement, card, Fortune, ward or wager settlement.
authoredRecords.name: House Compact
authoredRecords.description: Once per completed long rest. 2 AP, two distinct cards, two Fortune escrow (one per leg). Exactly two distinct willing OTHER allies within 30ft; one unresolved parent wager, two fixed leg identities. Each locks that ally’s next original single-d8 damage roll: face 5–8 returns two Fortune and adds FOUR raw damage before mitigation, otherwise no return/bonus. Each leg expires next caster own-turn start; cancelled, expired or next otherwise eligible event beyond 60ft loses its stake. Each card settles once. Parent stays locked until both close: no new wager or Recut. Payout plus remaining escrow never exceeds seven; discard overflow. Derived/duplicate events cannot pay and one event cannot match both legs.

authoredRecords.description: Add +1 / 2 / 3 raw wyrd on a winning optional damaging wager, once per action; Grand Wager chooses one recipient before rolling. Excludes core, signatures and capstones. Highest learned rank only; an unlearned optional spell stays unlearned. Manual tabletop only; no automatic costs, modifiers, draws or settlement.

Highest learned rank only; an unlearned optional spell stays unlearned. Manual tabletop only; no automatic costs, modifiers, draws or settlement.

acquisitionRecords.label: Real House wager
acquisitionRecords.text: Witnessed genuine pre-result wager establishing the channel: actual owned stake, declared settlement/cancellation and accepted loss; record wager and witness/source.

acquisitionRecords.label: Survived initiation
acquisitionRecords.text: Attested survival of the genuine initiating hazard-wager; supported background evidence is sufficient, never a new self-damage payment or manufactured near-death encounter.

acquisitionRecords.label: Wager discipline
acquisitionRecords.text: Supervised stake-before-result, losing-stake settlement, no refund, pending lock and discarded overflow; completion recorded, not inferred from temperament.

acquisitionRecords.label: Finite-deck training
acquisitionRecords.text: Demonstrated conservation of twenty actual cards, five-card hand, bounded draw and exact Recut/long-rest rules. No fabricated cards or reconnect reset.
